definitions.explanation: A person who has received a doctoral degree; an academic title.
A person with extensive knowledge in a particular field; often used colloquially or in nicknames.

examples.japanese: ⟦{彼|かれ}→彼：01292_kare⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{工学|こうがく}→工学：04862_kougaku⟧{博士|はかせ}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{学位|がくい}→学位：10196_gakui⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{持|も}っている→持つ：00478_motsu⟧。
examples.english: He has a PhD in engineering.

examples.japanese: ⟦うち→うち：27540_uchi⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{子|こ}→子：09851_ko⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{恐竜|きょうりゅう}→恐竜：10428_kyouryuu⟧{博士|はかせ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: My child is called a dinosaur expert.
examples.notes: Colloquial use for someone very knowledgeable

examples.japanese: {博士|はかせ}⟦{課程|かてい}→課程：02653_katei⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{修了|しゅうりょう}→修了：11655_shuuryou⟧⟦した→する：00392_suru⟧。

examples.english: That kid is a bug expert.

examples.japanese: ⟦{何|なん}でも→何でも：00304_nandemo⟧⟦{知|し}っているので→知る：00458_shiru⟧、⟦みんな→みんな：02972_minna⟧⟦から→から：00504_kara⟧{博士|はかせ}⟦と→と：00512_to⟧⟦{呼|よ}ばれている→呼ぶ：00766_yobu⟧。
examples.english: Since he knows everything, everyone calls him 'the professor.'

notes:
USAGE: {博士|はかせ} can refer to (1) an academic doctoral degree holder, or (2) colloquially, an expert in something. The reading はくし is also used in formal/academic contexts.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- {博士|はかせ}⟦{号|ごう}→号：04024_gou⟧ (doctoral degree)
- {博士|はかせ}⟦{課程|かてい}→課程：02653_katei⟧ (doctoral program)
- {博士|はかせ}⟦{論文|ろんぶん}→論文：03787_ronbun⟧ (doctoral thesis)
- 〜{博士|はかせ} (Dr. ~, expert in ~)

ACADEMIC DEGREES:
- ⟦{学士|がくし}→学士：23251_gakushi⟧ (bachelor's degree)
- ⟦{修士|しゅうし}→修士：11098_shuushi⟧ (master's degree)
- {博士|はかせ}/{博士|はくし} (doctorate)

NOTE: In formal academic contexts, {博士|はくし} (on-reading) is preferred. {博士|はかせ} (kun-reading) is more colloquial and used in titles like 「〜{博士|はかせ}」.
